posts.cooked:
I feel like it could be justified; maybe something happened to his powers ("Do not put too much trust in your powers, for powers are tools, and all tools can fail" -- The Naturalist, Natural-born Vigor) and he can only partially transform. Like Kehrolyn from BattleCon. The playing cards and activating triggers represents him taking on ASPECTS of that creature, rather than the full form, and it balances itself fairly well. An extra card each turn in place of the passives of the form, and being able to activate triggers from a form you aren't in would help to neutralize the issue of feeling like the cards from a form you aren't in are dead cards.

Here's what I'm thinking:

Unstable Form

Select one of the following: [gazelle symbol] [rhino symbol] [croc symbol]
Until the start of your next turn, you may activate the chosen symbol as if you were in that form.

At the end of your turn, destroy all form cards.

 

That reduces the side effects of not being able to retrieve your forms, being that you would just stick in Rhino or Crocodile the whole time with no drawbacks.
